thread:
deploybot: preflight-eval result for candidate model redwood-textrun-v3.2.1 -> FAIL (region: eu-west-1). 95p latency regressed by ~210ms vs baseline. quality delta within tolerance. report: https://ci/reports/1746209999-eu-latency
release_manager: ugh. is this across all prompt suites or concentrated?
qa_lead: concentrated on long-context summarizer prompts and multi-turn chat samples (weights skewed toward EU customer corpus). reproduces consistently in our eu-west test cluster.
eng_runtime: last change that could affect this was PR #789 (kv_compress toggle + new kernel fallback). reproduces on A100-80 in eu-west sim. throwing extra memcpy on hot path.
sre_oncall: infra shows queuing increase around the same time; no OOMs, just higher tail. autoscaler triggered extra instances but latency still higher.
product_pm: customer impact? are requests failing or just slower? any errors surfaced?
qa_lead: mostly tail latency; p50/p90 fine, p95/p99 spikes. no correctness regressions found.
release_manager: okay. propose immediate mitigation: block global rollout of v3.2.1, route eu-west-1 traffic back to redwood-textrun-v3.2.0, then proceed with staggered non-EU canary if teams agree.
maria_ops: I can apply the route fallback now. intended command:
```
/deploybot route-pin --model redwood-textrun-v3.2.0 --region eu-west-1 --reason "preflight eu latency regression"
```
please confirm and I will run.
devex: QA please drop the focused EU prompt subset into the eval gate so we can add it to the automated preflight for future runs.
qa_lead: uploading focused set to eval-buckets: s3://redwood-evals/eu-latency-subset-2026-03-20 (10k samples) and added to the gating job config. link: https://ci/evals/1746210001
deploybot: ack. created ticket INF-12345 and applied provisional routing override (eu-west-1 -> v3.2.0) by request of maria_ops.
eng_runtime: i will run a bisect on PR #789 and attempt a revert candidate locally, aiming for a repro+fix within ~2h. will post findings.
sre_oncall: recommend also running warmup for KV cache and prefer racks with newer drivers in eu-west-1a while we triage.
product_pm: agree with mitigation. please prepare a short status update for EU customers and a note in release notes: "EU region: temporary fallback to previous model due to tail latency regression; investigating kernel path interaction."
maria_ops: posting incident update now to status.redwood.ai -> https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INF-12345
release_manager: thanks. decision: block global promotion; staged rollout allowed for non-EU regions after ops signoff. follow-up sync in 30m to decide unpin timeline. leaving thread open for updates.
eng_runtime: will update within 2h with repro/bisect result.
qa_lead: once eng_runtime has root cause, we'll rerun full prompt/eval set including the new EU subset before unpin.
product_pm: add to release notes checklist: note region fallback + link to incident ticket.
release_manager: closing interim decisions here — will re-open if new data.
